themes.theme: largest object unmodelled (slab, bare wall, clean clay)

The objects differ per deck, so the theme stays open.

themes.what: The same lift. The kit person's mannequin look (queue repeat 2) deferred with a measured A/B: the hair material is not the cause, the shell geometry and the pose are.

themes.theme: type sitting on or fighting the art (queue footer-veil-peaks-below-the-line at repeat 2)

Doctrine, because no chassis template exists in the upgrade lane; a deck_chassis measure of a fill over one element's box is the next step if a chassis keeps the knock.

themes.what: Engine (human): TXT.snapshot fogs a TXT.interior room to the sky hue (queue snapshot-stages-interiors-to-sky-hue), and the lastLight horizon band behind type (repeat 1). UPGRADE_BACKLOG 2026-10-15 item 4.

themes.theme: no contact, dirt or grime where things meet the ground; dead or empty region
themes.what: Read the evidence: per frame compositions (empty floors, a dead bottom band) the judges fixed with the camera; carried with this week's counts.
